img.caption: Fig 3: Calibration quality (ECE, 15-bin, lower is better) and intra-domain false-reject rate. R10 UniCR matches Ours on CLINC150 ECE (0.004 vs 0.005) but requires a learned logistic head; R11 TECP-14B is over-confident on MixATIS (ECE 0.47); QP-10shot over-rejects 86% of in-domain queries on CLINC150. Ours attains the lowest ECE on CLINC150 (0.005) and MixSNIPS (0.045) with zero training, while keeping false refusal within 4.6-20.8%.
